channel.title: GeoPulse. Geopolitics in brief
channel.description: Signal-first briefings on geopolitics, edited by Lavkesh Dwivedi.

item.title: Trump says war will be ‘over quickly’ as Israel hits Beirut for first time since ceasefire
item.description: US President Donald Trump said the war with Iran would be over quickly after Israel launched airstrikes on Beirut for the first time since the ceasefire. The attacks targeted Iranian-backed Hezbollah militants in the Lebanese capital.

item.title: India vows to crush terror 'ecosystem', a year after Pakistan conflict
item.description: India's government vowed to dismantle the country's terror ecosystem, a year after the conflict with Pakistan. The pledge was made by Home Minister Amit Shah in a speech to parliament.

item.title: Moscow threatens to hit embassies if Kyiv disrupts Putin’s parade
item.description: Russia threatened to retaliate against Ukrainian embassies if Kyiv disrupts President Vladimir Putin's Victory Day parade in Moscow. The warning was issued by the Russian Foreign Ministry. Ukraine war live: Moscow threatens to hit embassies if Kyiv disrupts Putin’s parade The Independent.

item.title: Man City manager Jeglertz always believed they could win WSL title
item.description: Manchester City manager Gareth Taylor's assistant, Camilla Jeglertz, expressed confidence in the team's ability to win the Women's Super League title. Jeglertz cited the team's strong squad and recent form.

item.title: Malaysia’s SD Guthrie cautious on outlook after Q1 profit dips on weak palm prices
item.description: Malaysia's SD Guthrie saw its first-quarter profit decline due to weak palm oil prices. The company's revenue fell 12% year-on-year, with palm oil contributing to the decline. Malaysia’s SD Guthrie cautious on outlook after Q1 profit dips on weak palm prices.

item.title: HSA takes down nearly 1,000 illegal health product listings; over 80% were for contact lenses
item.description: Health authorities seized over 6,600 items and took down nearly 1,000 illegal health product listings, mostly for contact lenses. More than 6,600 items were also seized during a two-week operation that was part of an Interpol-led global crackdown on illegal health products.

item.title: Hazmat Suits On, Health Authorities Evacuate Suspected Hantavirus Patients From Cruise Ship
item.description: Health authorities evacuated suspected hantavirus patients from a cruise ship, with the WHO chief posting images of the evacuations. The WHO chief, Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus, posted images of the evacuations.

item.title: Senior Hezbollah Commander Killed In Israeli Strike On Beirut
item.description: An Israeli strike on Beirut killed a senior Hezbollah commander during a meeting in the Ghobeiri stronghold. The strike hit a meeting of Radwan leaders in Ghobeiri, a Hezbollah stronghold (Representational).

item.title: Hantavirus Has 38 Strains, Only 1 Spreads To Humans: New Updates In Atlantic Cruise Outbreak
item.description: The hantavirus has 38 strains, but only one spreads to humans, as seen in the Atlantic cruise outbreak. Atlantic cruise outbreak where one hantavirus strain is recorded to transmit from human to human.

item.title: Hantavirus Patients Land in Amsterdam With More Cruise Ship Evacuations Planned
item.description: Three people with possible hantavirus symptoms were evacuated from the MV Hondius cruise ship in Amsterdam. Three people with possible symptoms of the disease were evacuated on Wednesday morning from the MV Hondius before it headed to the Canary Islands.

item.title: New York judge makes alleged Esptein suicide note public
item.description: A New York judge made public a handwritten note allegedly written by Jeffrey Epstein, found after his first suicide attempt. The note's authenticity could not be verified. Epstein was a convicted sex offender.

item.title: Trump takes another U-turn on Iran
item.description: US President Trump eased sanctions on Iran, allowing American companies to sell food and medicine to the country. The move comes amid ongoing diplomatic efforts between the US and Iran.

item.title: "Watcha Want Me To Do? Bust Out Crying": Epstein Note Before Suicide Attempt
item.description: A note allegedly written by Jeffrey Epstein before his suicide attempt was discovered by a fellow inmate. The note reads "Watcha Want Me To Do? Bust Out Crying". Epstein was found on the floor of their cell.

item.title: Bolivian police fire tear gas at protesting teachers
item.description: Bolivian police fired tear gas at protesters in La Paz, as teachers and other groups rallied against the government. The protests involved three separate groups. The police response was swift and forceful.

item.title: Photo shows Israeli soldier desecrating Virgin Mary statue in Lebanon
item.description: Israel's military launched an investigation after a photo showed an Israeli soldier desecrating a Virgin Mary statue in Lebanon. The soldier placed a cigarette into the statue's mouth. The incident sparked outrage and condemnation.

item.title: How Hantavirus Usually Travels In Closed Spaces
item.description: Hantavirus typically spreads through contact with infected rodents or their droppings, and then to humans. In closed spaces, the virus can be transmitted through airborne particles, often resulting in severe respiratory symptoms. Early detection and treatment are crucial to prevent complications.

item.title: Hantavirus-hit cruise ship leaves Cape Verde after three evacuated
item.description: The MV Hondius cruise ship, on which a British man and two others showed hantavirus symptoms, left Cape Verde after the patients were evacuated to the Netherlands. The ship had been docked in Cape Verde when the outbreak occurred. Authorities took swift action to contain the situation.

item.title: Iran-US-Israel War News Live Updates: Iran expected to respond to US war proposal after Trump hails
item.description: Iran is expected to respond to a US war proposal after President Trump expressed optimism about a potential agreement. The situation remains tense as Iran considers the proposal. US officials are awaiting a response from their Iranian counterparts.

item.title: Rubio to visit India for bilateral talks; Quad Foreign Ministers’ meeting May-end
item.description: Rubio will visit India for bilateral talks with Jaishankar, Doval, and Prime Minister Modi. Rubio will hold talks with Jaishankar and Ajit Doval, and call on Prime Minister Modi, in discussions that are expected to set the course for India-U. S.

item.title: Argentina races to find origins of cruise ship hantavirus outbreak, amid reports some passengers
item.description: Argentina is investigating the source of a hantavirus outbreak on the MV Hondius cruise ship, which departed from the country. Argentina has the highest incidence of hantavirus in the region, according to the WHO. Officials are working to determine if the country is the origin of the outbreak.
